title: Video Pipeline v2 — Blurred BG + SRT Captions + AI Scene Selection + Brief Eval
goal: Full rework of the video production pipeline based on real TikTok archival content patterns. Four improvements: (1) blurred background composite replaces crop, (2) IA ASR transcript → Claude picks best segment, (3) word-level SRT captions + Claude storytelling narration burned throughout, (4) DeepEval-style virality gate on briefs before video production.

improvements.1_blurred_bg: Replace center-crop with blurred background composite — original video centered on blurred fill, no content lost
improvements.2_scene_selection: Download IA .asr.srt → Claude reads transcript → returns best start_seconds and content summary
improvements.3_caption_narration: Burn SRT word captions at bottom + Claude storytelling narration overlay — single ffmpeg pass
improvements.4_brief_eval: Claude GEval-inspired scorer — rates hook virality, caption quality, hashtag relevance before video production

tasks.context:
Create /Users/tarekmnif/kognai/workspace/tools/clip-maker/src/scene-selector.ts

Uses Claude (claude-haiku-4-5-20251001) to analyze the transcript and select the most viral segment, then generate a storytelling narration script.

Exports:
```typescript
export interface NarrationSegment {
  text: string;    // 3-7 words, storytelling line
  start: number;   // seconds from clip start (0-based)
  end: number;     // seconds from clip start
}

export interface SceneSelection {
  start_seconds: number;  // where to start the clip in the source video
  summary: string;        // 1 sentence: what's happening in this segment
  narration: NarrationSegment[];  // 5-7 storytelling lines timed to the clip
}

export async function selectScene(
  identifier: string,
  transcript: SrtSegment[],  // from fetchSRT()
  brief: { title: string; hook: string; topic_name: string; duration_seconds: number; viral_trigger: string },
  fallbackStart?: number     // default 8 — used if transcript is empty
): Promise<SceneSelection>;
```

Prompt to Claude:
```
You are a TikTok viral video editor specializing in archival footage.

VIDEO: {brief.title}
TOPIC: {brief.topic_name}
HOOK: {brief.hook}
CLIP LENGTH: {brief.duration_seconds}s
VIRAL TRIGGER: {brief.viral_trigger}

TRANSCRIPT (with timestamps):
{first 120 lines of transcript as: [0:12] text here}

TASK:
1. Find the most viral {brief.duration_seconds}-second window — where the MOST SHOCKING or AWE-INSPIRING moment happens based on the transcript
2. Generate a {brief.duration_seconds}s storytelling narration script (5-7 short segments)

Return JSON:
{
  "start_seconds": <integer — where to start in the source video>,
  "summary": "<1 sentence: what happens in this segment>",
  "narration": [
    {"text": "<3-7 words>", "start": <0-based seconds>, "end": <seconds>},
    ...
  ]
}

Narration style: present tense, dramatic, like a TikTok narrator.
First narration segment: start=0, end=4 (replaces the hook)
Distribute remaining segments evenly across the clip duration.
Return ONLY valid JSON.
```

If transcript is empty (silent film), fall back to:
- start_seconds = fallbackStart (8)
- narration generated from brief.hook + brief.title alone (still call Claude but without transcript)

Max 90 lines.
tasks.acceptance_criteria: selectScene() returns a SceneSelection with start_seconds >= 0, narration.length >= 5, all narration text <= 7 words

tasks.description: caption-composer.ts — single-pass ffmpeg: blurred bg composite + SRT captions + narration overlay
tasks.context:
Create /Users/tarekmnif/kognai/workspace/tools/clip-maker/src/caption-composer.ts

Replaces both clip-extractor.ts and text-overlay.ts with a single comprehensive ffmpeg pass.

Exports:
```typescript
export interface ComposeOptions {
  startSeconds: number;           // from SceneSelection.start_seconds
  durationSeconds: number;        // brief.duration_seconds
  srtSegments: SrtSegment[];      // from windowSegments() — 0-based
  narration: NarrationSegment[];  // from SceneSelection.narration
}

export async function composeClip(
  inputPath: string,
  outputPath: string,
  opts: ComposeOptions
): Promise<void>;
```

ffmpeg filter chain (single pass):

**Step 1 — Blurred background composite:**
```
[0:v]scale=1080:1920:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1080:1920,boxblur=40:3[bg];
[0:v]scale=1080:-2[fg];
[bg][fg]overlay=(W-w)/2:(H-h)/2[composed]
```

**Step 2 — SRT captions at bottom (from srtSegments):**
- Write a temp .srt file (windowSegments already 0-based)
- Use subtitles filter with Impact font, white, 38px, bottom margin 80px:
```
[composed]subtitles='/tmp/captions_{hash}.srt':force_style='FontName=Impact,FontSize=38,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF,OutlineColour=&H00000000,BorderStyle=1,Outline=3,MarginV=80,Alignment=2'[sub]
```

**Step 3 — Narration overlay segments at top (from narration[]):**
- One drawtext per narration segment
- Font: Impact, 72px, white, 4px border
- Position: x=(w-text_w)/2, y=160 (TikTok safe zone top)
- enable='between(t,{start},{end})'
- Build as: [sub]drawtext=...[n0];[n0]drawtext=...[n1];...[nN] → or chain them
- Write narration text to temp files (avoid escaping)

**Output:**
- videoCodec: libx264, crf 22, preset fast
- audioCodec: aac 128k (or copy if no SRT audio sync needed)
- movflags: +faststart

Clean up all temp files on success and error.

Max 100 lines.
